name: Clinic Intent Jev with LLM Escalation

parameters.formDescription: Upload a CSV exported from Golden Dataset Full. No score columns to fill. Jev classifies USER_INPUT; low-confidence decisions go to an LLM judge. This is an evaluation and performs no calendar actions.

parameters.content:
## Jev confidence escalation
Connect the same OpenRouter Header Auth credential to **Call Jev Intent** and **Call LLM Judge** (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`).

Export Golden Dataset Full as CSV, execute and upload. Only USER_INPUT goes to Jev; the LLM sees the input and candidate intent. No human labels or Jev confidence are sent to the LLM.

Confidence < 0.70 or a Jev error triggers review. CLARIFY / HUMAN_REVIEW remain unresolved. High confidence can still be wrong: audit a sample and verify actions separately. No calendar actions are performed.
